# n2 - Sweep: the merge abort, the reclaim, and the extension

`RunnerSweep.run(context)` is the first thing every `step` does. It aborts the whole step when
`MERGE_HEAD` resolves in the intent worktree, reclaims `running` nodes whose lease expired, and
extends the ones whose branch is still gaining commits, at most twice per attempt.

An extension cannot be a ledger state: the transition layer refuses `running` on a node that is
already running, and correctly so. So an extension is one line appended to
`packets/<node>--a<N>.extensions`, carrying the observed head sha and the time. The third expiry
reclaims regardless of new commits.

A reclaim line carries the landed commits (C11) so the next attempt's packet can show them under
"already landed", which `node-packet` already builds.

## n2 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2.1 | Abort the step when `MERGE_HEAD` resolves | The runner dispatches on top of a half-finished merge and the next node's diff carries someone else's conflict markers | `runner_sweep_test#test_merge_head_aborts_step` |
| 2.2 | Abort before the ledger or `graph.md` is written (meld of minor 26) | The abort happens after a reclaim line lands, so a step that refused still changed the ledger | `runner_sweep_test#test_merge_head_abort_leaves_ledger_and_graph_unchanged` |
| 2.3 | Leave a clean tree alone | `MERGE_HEAD` detection false-positives and no step ever runs | `runner_sweep_test#test_clean_tree_does_not_abort` |
| 2.4 | Reclaim an expired `running` node with no new commits | A crashed node stays `running` forever and its successors never become ready | `runner_sweep_test#test_expired_node_with_no_commits_is_reclaimed` |
| 2.5 | Leave an unexpired `running` node alone | A live node is reclaimed under a working executor and two agents write the same files | `runner_sweep_test#test_unexpired_node_is_not_reclaimed` |
| 2.6 | Extend an expired node whose branch has commits newer than its expiry | A slow but working executor is killed at the lease boundary and its work is thrown away | `runner_sweep_test#test_expired_node_with_new_commits_is_extended` |
| 2.7 | Cap extensions at two per attempt | A wedged executor that commits noise extends forever and the node never reclaims | `runner_sweep_test#test_third_expiry_reclaims_despite_new_commits` |
| 2.8 | Count extensions per attempt, not per node | Extensions from a previous attempt count against the current one and a fresh dispatch reclaims on its first expiry | `runner_sweep_test#test_extension_count_resets_per_attempt` |
| 2.9 | Record the extension with the observed head sha | An extension is unauditable and nobody can tell which commit justified it | `runner_sweep_test#test_extension_line_records_head_sha_and_time` |
| 2.10 | Write `reclaimed` with `holder=` and `expired=` | The line is refused for a missing required field and the node stays `running` | `runner_sweep_test#test_reclaim_line_carries_required_fields` |
| 2.11 | Record the landed commits on the reclaim | The next attempt redoes work that already landed and the merge conflicts with itself | `runner_sweep_test#test_reclaim_records_landed_commits` |
| 2.12 | Never reclaim a node that is `done` | A `done` node whose old `running` line happens to have expired reverts to planned and re-dispatches | `runner_sweep_test#test_done_node_is_never_reclaimed` |
| 2.13 | Survive a node whose worktree or branch is gone | Sweep raises on a missing branch and no other node is ever swept | `runner_sweep_test#test_missing_node_branch_does_not_raise` |
| 2.14 | Survive a torn `running` line | A crash-truncated line is parsed as a lease and sweep compares against a nil expiry | `runner_sweep_test#test_torn_running_line_is_skipped` |
| 2.15 | Report every reclaim and extension in the step report | The watch in 340a has no record of what sweep did, which is what C30 asks for | `runner_sweep_test#test_report_lists_reclaims_and_extensions` |
| 2.16 | Touch the intent lease after the abort check, never before it | `delivery.lock` goes stale mid-run and another session takes the intent over; touching first makes row 2.2's "nothing written" false | `runner_sweep_test#test_heartbeat_runs_after_abort_check` |
| 2.17 | Print the command that clears a stuck `MERGE_HEAD` (D30, meld of major 21) | The runner dies between its own merge and its abort, and every later step aborts with no way out | `runner_sweep_test#test_merge_head_abort_prints_recovery_command` |
| 2.18 | Derive the extension file's attempt number from the ledger (meld of minor 25) | Extensions are written against the wrong attempt and the cap counts the previous attempt's lines | `runner_sweep_test#test_extension_attempt_number_comes_from_ledger` |
| 2.19 | Skip the reclaim pass for any node named in a `--return` of the same step (D27, meld of major 9) | A node whose executor finished just past its lease is reclaimed and its finished work is thrown away | `runner_sweep_test#test_returned_node_is_not_reclaimed` |
| 2.20 | Run the reclaim pass after absorb, not before it | The same race as 2.19, one layer up: the order itself is what loses the work | `runner_sweep_test#test_reclaim_pass_runs_after_absorb` |
| 2.21 | Register `runner_sweep.rb` in `core_files` (D25) | `install_sync_test` goes red as soon as `scripts/runner` requires it | `install_sync_test#test_core_files_match_disk` |

## Steps
